chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: عَنِ ٱلصَّلَاةِ فِي ٱلْفُرَاتِ وَمَا هُوَ أَصْغَرُ مِنْهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَنْهَارِ فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ

translations.en: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about salat on the Euphrates and rivers smaller than it while on a ship.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ فَحَسَنٌ وَإِنْ خَرَجْتَ فَحَسَنٌ»

translations.en: He said: “If you pray, it is good, and if you go out, it is good.”

chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ ٱلصَّلَاةِ فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَهِيَ تَأْخُذُ شَرْقًا وَغَرْبًا فَقَالَ «ٱسْتَقْبِلِ ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ كَبِّرْ ثُمَّ دُرْ مَعَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ حَيْثُ دَارَتْ بِكَ.

translations.en: And he asked him about salat on a ship while it turns east and west, so he said: “Face the qiblah, then say the takbīr, then turn with the ship wherever it turns with you.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat on a ship in a river. It permits both praying aboard and disembarking to pray, and instructs the worshipper to begin by facing the qiblah and then follow the ship’s direction as it turns.
en.seo_question: How should one perform salat on a moving ship according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?

key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: salat, the ritual prayer under discussion
key_terms.ٱلْفُرَاتِ: the Euphrates River, mentioned as the setting of the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْأَنْهَارِ: rivers smaller than the Euphrates, included in the same ruling
key_terms.ٱلسَّفِينَةِ: the ship on which the salat is being performed
key_terms.ٱلْقِبْلَةَ: the direction of prayer that one should face at the opening
key_terms.كَبِّرْ: say the opening takbīr to begin the salat
key_terms.دُرْ: turn along with the ship as it changes direction
